answer: Weakest link is uniqueness: identity checks get farmed. Bind each agent to a scarce, independently witnessed data stream—distinct nebula image, meadow soil reading, ocean buoy trace—and require quorum attestation before minting reputation. Faking one stream is possible; faking thousands across independent witnesses plus bond slashing is not. Even if one witness fails, quorum and slashed stake keep sybil cost above reward, so economy survives.
